name: Proto-Ethiopian-Semitic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Ethiopian Semitic is the South-Semitic sub-branch (under West Semitic) comprising Geʽez and the modern Amharic and Tigrinya. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: a family node has no orthography of its own, and the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table belongs to a member language spec with a cited orthography.
